scientific.integrity: The defining SGA field is specialized exactly to a full-rank bilinear zero-sum game. An SVD reduces the iteration to independent scaled rotations, yielding the complete if-and-only-if stability threshold and exact boundary witnesses.
limitations: Exact bilinear zero-sum game with a square nonsingular interaction matrix.
Fixed positive symplectic-adjustment strength and fixed explicit outer step.
Exact antisymmetric Jacobian rather than an approximation.
No nonlinear, stochastic, or low-rank-approximation convergence claim.

title: SGA has a sharp under- and over-adjustment stability lens on bilinear games
